Per instructions, a similar-sounding filename/title is not accepted as identity confirmation -- this document is REJECTED as evidence for catalog row 9A273AA.

dns_dealer_fallback_rule.rule_text: dns-shop.ru (www.dns-shop.ru product pages; drv.dns-shop.ru manuals/drivers) may be used as a FALLBACK source for any catalog row when official characteristics, photos, or instructions are insufficient. The official source always has priority over DNS on any field. Every DNS-sourced field must carry its own URL, its own provenance record, and its own exact model+variant verification -- a dealer product card is never imported wholesale, and identity is never confirmed by a similar title alone. On any conflict between an official value and a DNS value for the same field, the field goes to human review; the official value is kept, the DNS value is not silently substituted.
dns_dealer_fallback_rule.tested_this_stage_on: 9A273AA only. No other catalog row was touched. No DNS crawl beyond the two user-provided URLs (one product page, one PDF).
dns_dealer_fallback_rule.test_outcome: The rule worked as designed: the DNS-linked PDF was checked on its own content (not accepted on filename similarity) and correctly rejected as a mismatch for this row. No field was imported from DNS this stage, because none passed verification.
